entry_points.text: Zspage choice scans fullness bands from high to low returning the first available; write-error handling locks the folio and records the error only if it still belongs to the mapping.

Global hooks build eviction shadows after locked unreferenced checks with gen delegation, pick demotion targets under mask preferring configured then closest, order nodes with used-mask recording, and read per-group and node stats and recency sizes with guards.

Per-lruvec shrink loops budget, aging and bounded evict batches reporting rotation need; address walk restarts at user start, aborts on max move, try-locks the mm, walks with skip and batched accounting then flushes; eviction flushes empty oldest gens around isolation, handles writeback once, reactivates rejected oldest and second-passes unmapped clean; gen node shrink sets plug, walk and priority, preserves background tallies and clears hopelessness on progress unless writepage or unmap is barred.

exports.text: Request size plus handle overhead selects a size class, index climbing from a floor and saturating at the last class.
Scanned-context swap writeout reports success without I/O.
Monotonic unsigned stat views with node fallback and clamping, zone-sum across a node, and time-gated stats flush.

hazards.text: Busy check freezes expected count before dirty test to avoid losing concurrent dirty transitions; partial zspage build on exhaustion releases counted pages and parent with no half chain visible.

Minimum advance promotes leftovers with tiered protection, skipping swappiness-excluded types and stalling on bounded budget exhaustion; max over stuck minima risks cold-hot inversion curbed by skips, clamping and dual-side rebalance; one gen-shrink variant fails the build if selected; isolation races release, cost sampling must survive wrap, proactive scans watch signals, background reclaim stalls on writeback cycling or congestion rather than spinning.

invariants.text: Control metadata comes from dedicated caches in directly accessible unmovable memory; new zspages carry magic, pool and class identity with unlocked guard, movability stripped when compaction is off.

Backing pages are taken singly per node, flagged for the allocator with sticky mark, counted in a dedicated zone stat and returned to buddy on free; first-object offset is bounded and valid only on flagged pages.
Alloc consumes the free head, advances via the stored link, stamps the handle with allocated mark (head descriptor for huge), updates occupancy and publishes the encoded location once in order.
Zone counts use per-CPU deltas spilling to global with hysteresis under preemption guard; one path assumes IRQs safe, the other saves and restores them.

Removal needs a locked folio whose mapping matches, rejects unfreezable or dirty, installs workingset shadow only for live reclaimed file-LRU non-DAX entries; file detach drops guards, queues shrinkable inodes and runs release hook if present.

Legacy swapout charges the nearest online ancestor over the range, clears the folio cgroup link and shifts memory to swap counters; root usage sums global file, anon and swap, others use dedicated counters; events split direction and volume with rate-gated threshold work, excess trees refreshed for group and ancestors.

Shadows fold cgroup, node, aged clock and history under file and anon masks; gen eviction either misses or charges history by kind and tier with width check; first use promotes exec files, later uses tier multiply-referenced; anon is treated clean, file flags refresh via fs verify when private state exists.

Demotion skips empty input or missing lower-tier allowed targets; FS entry allows FS mask or IO-only for swap cache unless backend forbids; isolation pressure exempts kswapd and wakes waiters when calm; all-dirty unqueued nudges flushers and folds tallies; inactive scarcity uses a rooted gigabyte ratio with floor.

Balance picks equal, fractional, file-only or anon-only from proactive, swap, swappiness, OOM priority, tiny-file and trim hints; targets start reclaimable with protection scaling, priority shift and offline floor; swappiness prefers proactive override; shares blend refault costs keeping each side above a third; low protection skips first pass then uses minimum with cluster floor; anon aging needs swap or demotion; gen shrink drains, plugs, walks with rotation on success then releases; swap-delete helper here is a no-op.

Preference keeps anon-only, forces file-only when swap is barred or demotion is down with low swap; bloom slot is seq modulo count with lazy alloc and clear on new pass; per-type count is max minus min plus one within bounds; ctrl reset folds averages on carryover and clears slots; promotion installs next gen once and clears refs; isolation sticks to first type unless it yields no scan.

Scan needs empty destination within batch ceiling, enough generations and evictable inactive zoned entries of the wanted kind; proactive anon-only warns and skips when anon is stuck, offline takes all, otherwise protection then priority shrink; evictable sums clamped zone-gen counts between minima and max; aging forced past window, suppressed at default priority, else at edge.

Root-only fold of externally freed slab, file and buffer pages then clears staging; throttle denied only with local exemption; cost sampling under cost lock uses monotonic deltas with write-weighted IO and decay past quarter LRU, stable gen mode returns early else sets deactivation, trim and tiny hints.

Isolation takes an extra ref with atomic flag clear, resets history when unreferenced, treats early failures as contention; position sums averaged plus current refaulted and totals with gain; error is positive below refault floor or when gain-weighted ratios favour process with small bias.

locks.text: Zspage guard pairs lockdep map with spin guard and unlocked counter; movable marking sets the flag per descriptor in chain order only under its exclusive guard, warning on failure.

Swap-cluster guard with IRQs off covers swap-cache checks, host plus tree guards with IRQs off cover file checks, held to detach or abort; swapout accounting requires cluster guard with IRQs off and nests preemption guard for per-CPU stats.
Cgroup generation rotation holds the per-node list guard with IRQs saved across segment updates, splicing and counts.
Shared read-side guards cover generation history sampling and demotion preference selection, released before packing or choosing.

MM iteration holds the mm-list spin lock for queue, seq, head init, tail extend, stats fold and ref handoff after unlock; stats fold needs the lock with next-slot clear; batch and min-seq publication need the live lruvec lock.

state_machines.text: Zspage init chains every slot into one tagged free list with distinct tail terminator and head at start.
Rotation assigns a random bin, moves nodes among generation queues by head, tail, old and young ops with counts, advancing the global sequence once the oldest drains.

Reference check yields activate, keep or reclaim: locked, strongly referenced or exec file activates; contention or first-touch mapped keeps; unreferenced reclaims, with gen mode short-circuiting unreferenced to reclaim.

Without mm tracking generation advances directly, otherwise a full mm pass is required with no-walk fallback when young-bit or walk is missing; no-walk moves only on newer seq; max increment is single-winner, lifting minima with reschedule, rebalancing compat sizes, refreshing control then release-publishing.

Oldest-generation scan rotates zones from the reclaim ceiling, offers each resident to protect then isolate, parks contended for reattach and stops on quota or batch floors; triage relocates promoted, saturated or ineligible; tier search climbs gains until error clears, type pins at swappiness extremes else compares positions; abort on proactive signal or target met with tier-aware watermarks for kswapd; node reclaim prefers stable gen path else cycles members, folds freed pages, records pressure, flags writeback and throttles while continuation holds.

structs.text: Zspage links descriptors by next with parent back-pointers, cached flagged head and huge marker for lone object in lone page; thresholds form an ordered array with cursor for highest crossed entry signalling both directions; vector lookup returns the group per-node vector or the global when ungrouped.

Scan control plus vector, position, cost and generation-store dimensions: control holds targets, modes, masks, costs and accumulators; vector holds gen state and locks; gen store is indexed by generation, type and zone with swappiness-bounded evictable iteration.
MM tracking is build-dependent: enabled gives per-cgroup list with global fallback and per-lruvec state with node filter and ref holding; disabled gives nulls with no selectable mm.

Object reference packs frame number with class and index in one word; active generation is global sequence modulo count; named sets and bound constants cover outcomes, balance, kinds, zones, batches, tiers, priorities, watermarks and throttle flags.
